name: Profile
author: Kilo Code
short: Create and manage user profiles with sticky messages.
description: Asks user a series of questions to create a profile embed in a specified channel. Uses sticky messages to keep the creation button accessible.
install_msg: Thanks for installing the profile cog!
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild/member profile questionnaire answers, picture URLs, profile message IDs, and deletion timestamps, plus legacy user-scoped copies during migration. Red data-deletion requests clear both scopes.
